findings.evidenceJa: 小春の白い肌に辿り着かずに
findings.explanation: Even after peeling back layer after layer, Haruki still has not reached Koharu's bare skin, which is what drives his mounting impatience. The translation says he exposes her skin, reversing the scene's physical progress.
findings.japanese:
めくっても、めくっても…
小春の白い肌に辿り着かずに、
じわじわと焦燥感に駆られる。
findings.todokanai: Layer by layer… I expose Koharu's fair skin spurred by my increasing impatience.

findings.highlight: torn off the last of her buttons and tossed her blazer aside
findings.evidenceJa: ボタンを外し、上着を脱ぎ捨てていく
findings.explanation: After Koharu urges him to undress too, Haruki tears open his own buttons and throws off his own outerwear. The translation assigns both garments and actions to Koharu, changing who is being undressed.
findings.japanese:
小春に言われるまでもなく、
引きちぎるようにボタンを外し、
上着を脱ぎ捨てていく。
findings.todokanai: Before Koharu could say anything, I'd already torn off the last of her buttons and tossed her blazer aside.

findings.highlight: a bitch that belongs to you alone
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩だけのビッチなんですから
findings.explanation: Koharu misunderstands the loanword ビッチ as though it could mean a sexually exclusive woman, which is why Haruki immediately says that her sentence makes no sense. English 'your bitch' is an ordinary, coherent expression, so the translation removes the mistake that creates the joke and makes Haruki's response inexplicable.
findings.japanese:
「…本当ですから。
わたし、先輩だけのビッチなんですから！」
findings.todokanai: "…Because it's true. I… I've become a bitch that belongs to you alone, Senpai!"

findings.highlight: she desperately tries to close her legs
findings.evidenceJa: 楽な方向へ逃げようと、一生懸命にぴんと張られる
findings.explanation: Koharu's legs are already open around Haruki and stretch rigidly toward whatever position may hurt less. The translation says she is trying to close them and escape him, reversing the described movement.
findings.japanese:
俺を挟み込むように開かれた両脚は、
必死で楽な方向へ逃げようと、
一生懸命にぴんと張られる。
findings.todokanai: As if trying to escape from me, she desperately tries to close her legs which I'd pried open.

findings.highlight: "I'll only show this perverted side of mine to you, Senpai… only to you, okay?"
findings.evidenceJa:
「先輩にだけ…
先輩にだけ、ですからね？
こんなかっこわるいわたし、見せるのは」
findings.explanation: かっこわるい俺 is Haruki's uncool or undignified self, while 'perverted side' moralizes and sexualizes the self-description.
findings.japanese:
「先輩にだけ…
先輩にだけ、ですからね？
こんなかっこわるいわたし、見せるのは」
findings.todokanai: "I'll only show this perverted side of mine to you, Senpai… only to you, okay?"
